question: What is the largest particle size reported in Table 2, and for which system?

trace.query: SELECT id, row_no, col_no, text FROM cells WHERE table_id='p6.T2' AND col_no IN (1,2,3,5,6) ORDER BY row_no, col_no

SELECT c.row_no, c.text, c.id, (SELECT string_agg(b.text, ' | ') FROM cells b WHERE b.table_id='p6.T2' AND b.row_no=c.row_no AND b.col_no=2) AS mat, (SELECT string_agg(b.text, ' | ') FROM cells b WHERE b.table_id='p6.T2' AND b.row_no=c.row_no AND b.col_no=5) AS tgt FROM cells c WHERE c.table_id='p6.T2' AND c.col_no=6 AND c.row_no>=50 ORDER BY c.row_no
SELECT row_no, col_no, text FROM cells WHERE table_id='p6.T2' AND row_no>=56 ORDER BY row_no, col_no
SELECT row_no, col_no, text, id FROM cells WHERE table_id='p6.T2' AND row_no BETWEEN 17 AND 25 ORDER BY row_no, col_no
